method: 8 bold markers, pixel positions read off gridded zooms (automatic detection failed and was abandoned), tape slant range marker centre -> lens centre. For each marker the zone whose ray points nearest that direction is compared to the tape. Floor used as an independent constraint via implied lens height.

result.verdict: fov_v 60.5 CONFIRMED. Markers 7 and 8 bracket the cone edge between 30.1 and 35.3 deg, consistent with the configured 30.25. No error comparable to the fov_h bug was found.

correction: An earlier plane-fit in this session reported a 4.46 deg floor tilt and was reported as a likely extrinsic pitch error. That was an artifact of the robust plane fit trimming onto a sloped subset. The direct test -- implied lens height vs the tape -- puts any pitch under ~2 deg and cannot resolve its sign or size. No pitch change is justified by this data.
recommendation: Change nothing. fov_v stays 60.5, rotation_rpy_deg stays [0,0,0].
